content:
If you're like me and have lost hours bouncing between Wikipedia pages through the random article feature, the official app now finally offers a way to do the same thing — albeit through a widget.

There's now finally a button that can take you directly to a random Wikipedia article.

Today's Wikipedia iOS app update adds an interesting and practical new feature: a "Random Article" widget that can be placed on the home screen of your iPhone or iPad.

The widget is available in both large and medium sizes, and comes with a cute mascot.

Tap the widget and it will take you straight to a completely random Wikipedia article, with "Random Mode" turned on by default.

Without leaving the app, all you need to do is keep pressing the "Random Article" button, and it will keep rolling the dice, taking you deeper and deeper into the maze of random articles.

Have fun, but watch the time slip away! Earlier this summer, the Wikipedia app already added a history quiz mini-game.

This brand-new widget has launched with today's update of the Wikipedia iPhone and iPad apps.

Make the most of your Apple devices
